title: Alkometriikka site notices
description: Banners shown under the header. See notes/notices.md and src/lib/utils/notices.ts.

id.description: Stable unique id. Dismissals are remembered per id, so use a new id to show a notice again.

level.description: `warning` is shown in amber with an alert icon.

link.description: Optional link shown after the message.

href.description: A site path (`/kategoriat`) or an `https://` URL; anything else is dropped.

startsAt.description: ISO timestamp; the notice is hidden before this.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp; the notice disappears on its own after this.

dismissible.description: Set to `false` to keep the notice up.

replacesStaleWarning.description: Hide the automatic stale-data warning while this notice is shown, e.g. to explain an outage.
